claims.text: Abstention can mitigate hallucinations in LLM systems.
Abstention can enhance safety in LLM systems.
Abstention in LLMs can be examined from three perspectives: the query, the model, and human values.

evidence.description: Abstention, the refusal of large language models (LLMs) to provide an answer, is increasingly recognized for its potential to mitigate hallucinations
Abstention, the refusal of large language models (LLMs) to provide an answer, is increasingly recognized for its potential to... enhance safety in LLM systems.
In this survey, we introduce a framework to examine abstention from three perspectives: the query, the model, and human values.

methodologies.name: Three-Perspective Abstention Survey Framework
methodologies.description: A framework that organizes abstention literature, methods, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics across the query, model, and human values perspectives.

limitations.text: Prior work on abstention methods, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics exhibits limitations across various perspectives.

future_work.text: Investigating whether abstention can be achieved as a meta-capability that transcends specific tasks or domains.
Exploring opportunities to optimize abstention abilities in specific contexts.
